chapters.title: The Short-Bus Outbreak
chapters.caption: The field trip begins
chapters.text: The yellow NeoTech minibus idles outside Apex Synthetic Bio-Corp. Mr. Henderson is already running low on enthusiasm. Timmy battles an air vent, Gary studies a greasy wrapper, and Angela hisses at a juice box. Then an experimental flask breaks—and the morning takes a turn.
chapters.quote: Rule number one: do not lick the radioactive containment vats.

chapters.title: The Parking Lot Standoff
chapters.caption: The quiet before the chaos
chapters.text: The bus sits dead beneath blinking hazard lights as the sidewalks empty. Timmy has wedged his coin somewhere permanent; Angela keeps an eye on a suspicious pen. Gary slowly turns toward the window. Outside, the quarantine zone is no longer quite so quiet.

chapters.title: The First Breach
chapters.caption: Emergency exit, meet forehead
chapters.text: A half-eaten pretzel ends the stillness. Gary nudges the emergency window open with his forehead, Angela scrambles over the seats, and Timmy charges down the aisle with a megaphone. The crew spills into a quarantine zone full of warnings—and questionable decisions.
chapters.quote: The bus doors hiss open. The misfits are officially outside.

chapters.title: The Line in the Asphalt
chapters.caption: A defense plan held together by snacks
chapters.text: Drawn by the commotion—and perhaps the pretzel—suburban wanderers drift toward the bus. Angela stands by the open door with a pink cape and slingshot; Timmy broadcasts warnings; Gary fixates on a yellow sneaker. Mr. Henderson remains at the wheel.
chapters.quote: Somehow, this counts as a plan.

chapters.title: The Emergency Bumper Tap
chapters.caption: A bump in the road
chapters.text: The minibus remains parked in the haze. Mr. Henderson rests on the horn, Timmy investigates a gum wrapper, and Angela hisses at a passing shadow. Then a bewildered zombie bumps into the rear bumper. Gary turns to inspect the unexpected visitor.
chapters.quote: The bus is still here. The zombie is now, too.

chapters.title: The Final Route
chapters.caption: Attendance is complicated
chapters.text: Traffic lights blink red and green at once. The minibus sits in the middle of the grid while survivors discover that the horde is just as easily distracted by snacks, hubcaps, and shiny objects as the crew. Sirens wail in the distance. Mr. Henderson offers one final attendance check.

characters.name: Timmy
characters.description: Megaphone in hand, ready to warn everybody about everything.

characters.name: Gary
characters.description: A thoughtful observer of wrappers, hubcaps, and mysteries.

characters.name: Angela
characters.description: Backward helmet, pink-cape courage, and suspicion of juice boxes.

characters.name: Mr. Henderson
characters.description: Substitute teacher and weary driver. Attendance always wins.
